html.body: Date: 2025-04-03 Amendments to the Drawings:Please replace the drawing sheets including Figures 2 and 5 with the attached replacement sheets, which includes amended Figures 2 and 5. No new matter has been added.REMARKSIn response to the Notice to File Corrected Application Papers dated March 13, 2025, Applicant submits amended Figures 2 and 5, in which the figure labels are oriented in the same direction as the figure.Accordingly, it is respectfully submitted that with the foregoing amendments, the present application is in proper formal condition for issuance. Further, in that the amendment was primarily required by the Office, relates merely to the correction of formal matters in the drawings, and no new matter has been added, it is respectfully requested that the foregoing amendments be entered and fully considered by the Office.The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any fees which may be required, or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 50-4525, under Docket No. 971300-000003.Respectfully submitted, /Randy A.
